notes.title: 2.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Quick hotfix:
- Fixed bug where powers would stay activated indefinitely when they were activated during the pre-game "GET READY..." phase of the game.
- Re-added gamepad vibrations for death and bomb explosions.

notes.title: L-RACERS Version 2.0!
notes.content:
After 2 years, L-RACERS has been revamped, revitalized, reimagined and rewritten!

- Introducing SPECIAL POWERS! These limited-use powers include stopping on a dime, dashing at double speed, or dropping explosive bombs for your opponent! This is the major update since this mechanic really changes the game.
- Resolution has been bumped up from 384x240 to 512x288.
- Refresh rate has been increased from 60Hz to 100Hz. This improves the responsiveness and smoothness of not only the graphics, but also the controls and even the networking as well. (Analogous to tick rate.)
- All menus and animations have been reworked to show extra love and care. You'll now see basic particle systems and alpha blending.
- As always, XInput-compatible gamepads are recommended, but keyboard is supported too.

notes.title: Update v1.0.5
notes.content:
- Player's name is now saved so you don't have to re-enter your name every new multiplayer game.
- If either player in a network game chooses to return to the main menu, a quit signal is sent to the remote player so that they also return to the main menu. Otherwise, we may try to continue playing against another player who isn't there anymore.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Update
notes.content: v1.0.4 Update: Added 3 new maps! Choose which map you want to play from the Options menu. In network games, the host decides which map you will play. Enjoy the new variability!

notes.title: v1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Update to version 1.0.3:
- Added support for fullscreen mode.
- Fixed a rare glitch where when both players simultaneously attempted to occupy the same point coming from perpendicular directions they might pass through one another instead of both crashing as intended.
